1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The no-change refusal is where the form's purpose meets removal; the gate keeps the use sound without testing resolution itself. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (nat→structured) and one EARS parent (structured→structured, a default cell) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
